name: Mansell v. Mansell
summary: The Supreme Court held that the Uniformed Services Former Spouses' Protection Act did not grant state courts the authority to treat military disability benefits as property divisible upon divorce, limiting the scope of state court power over federal benefit programs.
significance: This case illustrates that federal statutes can expressly limit what state divorce courts may treat as divisible marital property, particularly regarding military retirement pay, providing a precedent for federal constraints on state property division authority.
